text:
Nina: spun up atlas-512 (fp32) + int8-per-channel on staging for a short-query focused smoke (5k).
Omar: paste top-line numbers?
Jules: quick summary:
```
model                 recall@1  recall@5  p95_latency_ms
atlas-512-fp32        0.612     0.793     28.4
atlas-512-int8pc      0.589     0.774     15.6  # int8 PC narrows gap vs per-tensor
index: hnswlib M=24 ef_search=80 metric=cosine
```
Nina: loss concentrated in acronym and id-like queries.
Omar: try whitening+L2 norm and clamp=0.02 for quant run.
Jules: did that; after clamp + whitening recall@1 on short bucket rose to 0.603, latency 16.4ms.
Nina: good improvement. add failure pairs to eval artifacts and label the run with ef tag.
eval-bot: artifacts uploaded -> https://internal/redwood/runs/1759001234 (UMAPs, failure pairs, per-cohort tables).
Omar: next steps: 1) A/B 10% short queries to fp32 for 24h, 2) update onboarding doc recommending int8-per-channel + clamp for atlas-512 if A/B passes.
Nina: noted, leaving thread open until A/B done.
